en.title: Shigezane Date and Correspondence
en.summary: Correspondence with Shigezane Date. The opening reads: "I will list the letters received and sent by Shigezane in chronological order. I also plan to include letters in which Shigezane appears."
en.html:
I will list the letters received and sent by Shigezane in chronological order. I also plan to include letters in which Shigezane appears. For those that have been transcribed, I have provided a reading version. Since the web is horizontally written, I have added okurigana or replaced variant characters with appropriate ones to make them easier to read. As these are all my own personal interpretations, there may be errors. I would appreciate it if anyone who spots a mistake could let me know. I have added "free translations" to those I felt inclined to do. These are also my own personal interpretations, so please do not rely on them too heavily.
